title: Remedies are hypotheses: an affirmed remedy is not thereby the right one (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
here;s something important for the flow .... just because a remedy is affirmed, doesn't mean its the right one. 

A problem may have many remedies. 
We should notice when they are competing. 
We should ensure that we can see their relations

As we find potential remedies we will need to synthesise them to to find the right way forward. 

Remedies are hypotheses. We need to know what would make them succeed or fail as experiements
